cause: CSS HMR changes styles without a React commit or Plugin/Slot registration change. Previously neither the dev bridge requested a new observation after HMR nor the Runtime collected a fresh snapshot in response to the existing observation request; application observability only replayed cached evidence.
classification: Missing post-HMR collection, not a failure to apply styles; stale correctly classified the old evidence.
fix: Creator dev host bridge requests observations on vite:afterUpdate, with disposal cleanup.

Runtime listens to the existing generic Host observation-request seam and collects current registrations/geometry on the next frame. Same-frame requests coalesce; retiring Providers and unmounts remain protected.
Cached replay timestamps and Python freshness/hash/transaction checks unchanged.
Runtime verification log adds mutation/observation/receipt timestamps and compositionFresh.
platformReview: DOM Event/RAF/cleanup use browser APIs supported across platforms; no native path or process changes. Tests cover request coalescing, listener cleanup, retiring Provider suppression and stale cache semantics. Existing cross-platform pnpm helper used.
